newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-KAELIN FASTEST IN WORLD CUP GIANT FIRST RUN.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-KAELIN FASTEST IN WORLD CUP GIANT FIRST RUN.

text.p: Urs Kaelin of Switzerland was fastest in the first run of the men's World Cup giant slalom at Breckenridge, Colorado, on Saturday.

Starting third, Kaelin posted a time of 1:05.11 and then watched as a snow flurry befuddled later starters. Kjetil Andre Aamodt of Norway held second at 1:05.36, followed by Hans Knaus of Austria at 1:05.51, Steve Locher of Switzerland in 1:05.55 and Fredrik Nyberg of Sweden at 1:05.56.
A sudden snowstorm struck the 15th starter, Josef Strobl of Austria, and all who came after, severely hampering visibility.
